name: Token
description: `Token` displays compact filter or selection content with optional leading visuals, selection state, and removal behavior. `IssueLabelToken` provides the same token interaction model with a custom label color.

props.name: as
props.description: Element to render. Use `a` or `button` when the token is interactive.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Prevents interaction with the token and its remove button.

props.name: hideRemoveButton
props.description: Hides the remove button while `onRemove` still handles removal by keyboard.

props.name: href
props.description: Makes the token a link to the given URL.

props.name: id
props.description: Identifier applied to the root element.

props.name: isSelected
props.description: Marks the token as the current one in a list of tokens.

props.name: leadingVisual
props.description: Icon shown before the token's text.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Shows a remove button and is called when it is activated.

props.name: size
props.description: Height and text size of the token.

props.name: text
props.description: Label shown on the token.
